levels: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original isometric game building sprite, clean alpha cutout for a polished Clash of Clans-style mobile strategy game. Single Bomb Tower BASE ONLY, no skeleton or person. Full tower fills square canvas with transparent margin. Orthographic isometric camera looking down 30 degrees, two sides equally visible, upper-left sunlight, chunky carved warm wood, crisp beveled edges, colorful hand-painted 3D mobile-game look, readable at 120 pixels. Square wooden top platform with LOW battlement parapet and four strong corner posts. Exactly four small dark iron spherical bombs with tiny brass fuse sockets rest inside the roof, leaving the center open for a Bomber who will be composited separately. Four tapered heavy timber legs below the platform, open interior. One LARGE black spherical bomb rests on the ground in the open center beneath the tower, visible between legs. Each leg has a thick golden chain and dark charcoal steel spiked foot collar, protected by an outward-sloping short wooden shield panel with one iron pyramid spike. Small scattered pale stone footing under legs only. Square diamond footprint. No grass tile, environment, ground plane, background glow, shadows beyond the object, text, labels, characters or watermark. Actual RGBA transparent background outside the tower and through empty gaps; never a checkerboard. LEVEL 1: all parapet sides on top are warm wooden boards, with solid wooden corner blocks and small gray bolt heads. Wooden shield panels around the feet have NO perimeter steel plates. Simple dark spiked metal collars on footings and golden chains are visible.

prompts.bomber: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 4-frame sprite sheet for the small skeleton Bomber who stands on a Clash of Clans-style Bomb Tower. Actual transparent RGBA background. One horizontal row of FOUR equal square cells, generous transparent padding around each pose, identical camera and character proportions in every cell. Orthographic isometric camera looking down 30 degrees. Character faces screen lower-left in every frame. Ivory cartoon skeleton with large skull, toothy grin, black eye sockets, BLUE leather aviator helmet with earflaps, thick gold-rimmed blue-lens goggles, COPPER brown gloves, exposed bony ribcage, short legs and bare bone feet. No clothes apart from helmet/goggles/gloves. Rounded stylized mobile-game 3D render, crisp silhouette and bright upper-left lighting. This actor will be rendered about 32 pixels high on a tower. FRAME 1: idle, both gloves holding one dark charcoal spherical bomb with brass fuse socket at chest. FRAME 2: windup, same bomb held in right glove raised behind head, left glove extended to balance. FRAME 3: release, arm extended toward lower-left after throwing, EMPTY hands, NO flying bomb. FRAME 4: follow-through, right arm down forward, torso leaning slightly forward, EMPTY hands. Keep all feet on same baseline, same head/body size and fixed foot position. No tower, platform, ground, shadows, halo, backdrop, checkerboard, text or labels. Empty pixels must be truly transparent. There is exactly one skeleton in each cell.
prompts.deathBomb: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated game sprite of the Bomb Tower's exposed death bomb, to place on existing rubble after a wooden tower collapses. One LARGE round charcoal-black iron bomb with a small brass fuse collar and a short curved rope fuse whose very tip has a tiny orange ember. Polished dark iron with broad soft highlight, gently hammered texture, thick simple cartoon mobile-game 3D forms, upper-left lighting, isometric orthographic view 30 degrees down. Low on its base but fully visible. No other bombs, no debris, no ground plane, no smoke, no glow around the outside, no cast shadow, no scenery, no text. Square canvas, centered with 15% transparent margin. Actual RGBA transparency outside the object; no checkerboard or colored background.

notes: Original generated artwork. Supercell client data supplies gameplay values; no extracted game artwork is distributed. Deterministic alpha trimming, resampling and compositing only.
